sourceOccurrences.label: Hierarchical radial model bounds
sourceOccurrences.locator: Named statement start lines in the pinned source: 50, 91, 122, 147, 155, 164, 173
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected statement correspondence with scope qualifications
sourceOccurrences.note: The seven named theorems concern ball-count upper bounds, radial sums, total mass at most 2C, descent to unordered pairs, and three intensity applications. 9408 and 6KJQ give stronger exact shell formulas; these are not attributed to the source, which proves only upper bounds. B6KD includes its conservative 2C susceptibility and threshold bounds and the d=1, L=2, C=1, r=1/4 witness. The algebraic descent also holds at zero modulus without the nonzero-modulus assumption used for the finite ball counts; the final paragraph explains this separate scope. KL29 is an expository addition.

sourceOccurrences.label: Exact geometry, child blocks and full radial summability
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected exposition with explicit additional deductions
sourceOccurrences.note: BW7V extends the support geometry to arbitrary Abelian coefficient groups and proves the disjoint child partition. Existing 9408/6KJQ retain finite counts and radial grouping. YW7B gives the extended geometric identity and full nondegenerate summability equivalence, including divergent ratios. The nonzero-modulus condition for finite counts and positive-dimension/scale conditions for the power equivalence are explicit.

sourceOccurrences.label: Extended hierarchical two-point bound
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected exposition with explicit additional deductions
sourceOccurrences.note: 0K45 retains all finite beta>=0, C>=0 and r<=1, with an extended off-diagonal mass and two geometric factors. Its finite small-intensity specialization is stated separately. Diagonal erasure extends the source canonical radial diagonal to arbitrary marginals. The direct-edge lower comparison is an additional deduction. The original critical two-point article and all its assertions remain unchanged.

sourceOccurrences.note: The source gives almost-sure confinement under a zero-outside profile, the exact extended omitted row, and the sharp finite-row specialization. Its radial-kernel hypothesis also fixes diagonal values; diagonal invariance recovers arbitrary loop parameters.
